legend.Mainnet: adapter deployed on X Layer mainnet and exercised there with real transactions
legend.Fork-tested: adapter deployed on X Layer mainnet; behaviour proven by fork tests against live chain state
legend.Agent-only: agents are checked; the wallet's own owner key or keys are not
legend.Partial: pre-execution checks work, with a known way to remove the hook or skip the timelock

fields.adapterLiveOnMainnet: address of the adapter on X Layer mainnet (release v2), or null
fields.preExecutionCheck: every call checked by the circuit before it executes
fields.outcomeCheck: FengceInspector checks balances and approvals after execution
fields.safeConfigInvariants: FengceInspector also fails the transaction if owners, threshold, modules, guards or fallback handler change
fields.uninstallAdminProtection: what stops the hook or guard from being removed or bypassed quickly
fields.agentOnly: only agents are checked, not the wallet's own owner key or keys
fields.isBound: FengceBinding.isBound can return true for this wallet

testedWalletTypesNote: wallets whose adapter has a passing test (tests != "none"); see docs/CLAIMS.md#wallet-types-8

wallets.testEnvironment: X Layer mainnet; X Layer mainnet fork
wallets.safeConfigInvariants: yes (owners, threshold, modules, guards, fallback handler)
wallets.uninstallAdminProtection: admin timelock (at least 1 day); guard removal only by recovery: all owners, at least 2 days
